subject.title: fix(reef): bound legacy state file reads in doctor migration

question: Should Reef doctor migrations process valid oversized legacy state through a bounded streaming path, or intentionally refuse it with a supported preservation and recovery workflow?
rationale: The cap is a product and upgrade contract for persistent user state; source review cannot determine whether refusal is acceptable without owner intent and a defined recovery experience.

options.title: Stream and migrate oversized state
options.body: Keep memory bounded while incrementally processing valid audit and replay records so existing durable state remains migratable.

options.title: Refuse with supported recovery
options.body: Retain the size caps only if doctor preserves the original files and presents documented, actionable recovery or export steps for oversized state.

options.title: Pause this change
options.body: Defer the cap until the intended durable-state compatibility contract is agreed and testable.

recommendation.title: Stream and migrate oversized state
recommendation.body: Keep memory bounded while incrementally processing valid audit and replay records so existing durable state remains migratable.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the proposed migration boundary and can incorporate the selected contract, subject to repository-owner direction.
